options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Game Mode
options.doc:
Choose the game mode where you will be playing.
Adventure: Enables Adventure mode.
Gauntlet: Enables Gauntlet mode both Survival and Practice.
Explorer: Play Both Modes.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez le mode de jeu où vous allez jouer.
Adventure: Active le mode Aventure.
Gauntlet: Active le mode Gauntlet à la fois survie et pratique.
Explorer: Jouez les deux modes.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Choose the Level to complete for your Goal
Space: Beat the level Space
Random: picks a random lvl of the list
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez le niveau à compléter pour votre objectif
Space: Battre le niveau Espace
Random: choisit un lvl aléatoire de la liste

options.name: Goal Level Mode
options.doc:
"
When the exploration Mode is played, picks to what mode will be the goal level assigned.

When picking option both:
space Goal,  allows the player to goal by beating either version.
random, will pick a random level for each mode,

random One will select one of the modes to have the goal
options.doc_fr:
"
Lorsque le mode d'exploration est joué, il choisit le mode qui sera le niveau de but assigné.

Lors de la sélection des deux options:
espace Objectif, permet au joueur de viser en battant l'une ou l'autre version.
aléatoire, choisira un niveau aléatoire pour chaque mode,

aléatoire On choisira l'un des modes pour avoir le but

options.name: Sun Idols
options.doc:
The amount of Sun Idols that will be Scattered around the multiworld.

Will be cap depending on the amount of final checks.
Max around adventure ~100~
Max around gauntlet ~200~

options.name: Required Sun Idols
options.doc:
The percentage of Sun Idols required to goal by beating the goal level.
Will unlock space in adventure.
Will let you play the goal difficulty for the level in gauntlet.

Max will be one less than the amount of Sun Idols.

options.name: Useful Sun Idols
options.doc:
After you unlock the goal level, each extra SunIdol will make the level easier until the selected percentage.

At this amount of Sun idols:
Space will have the vanilla requirement in adventure.
Gauntlet will goal at the first level of goal difficulty

if smaller than the required Sun idols, will be set to one higher
options.doc_fr:
Après avoir débloqué le niveau de but, chaque SunIdol supplémentaire rendra le niveau plus facile jusqu'au pourcentage sélectionné.

A cette quantité d'idoles du Soleil:
L'espace aura l'exigence de vanille dans l'aventure.
Gauntlet va viser au premier niveau de difficulté

si plus petit que les idoles requises du Soleil, sera mis à un supérieur

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
When you lose a live or get game over, the other player will also die.
the opposite is also true.

options.name: Ace Time
options.doc: Add the Ace-Time of each level as locations.
options.doc_fr: Ajouter l'As-Time de chaque niveau comme emplacement.

options.name: Coins per Section
options.doc:
Choose the multiplier percentage to the amount of coins needed per Section (Board Difficulty or Stage) to send the location.

The base amount is calculated on the amount of levels per Section, 7 in gauntlet, 5-7 in adventure.

For reference decimals will go up.
50% : 4 gauntlet 3-4 adventure
150% : 11 gauntlet 8-11 adventure
Minimum will be 1 coin.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez le pourcentage multiplicateur à la quantité de pièces nécessaires par Section (Board Difficulté ou étape) pour envoyer l'emplacement.

Le montant de base est calculé sur le montant des niveaux par section, 7 en guntlet, 5-7 en aventure.

Pour les décimales de référence montera.
50% : 4 gantelets 3-4 aventure
150% : 11 gauntlet 8-11 aventure
Le minimum sera 1 pièce.

options.name: Gaps per Section
options.doc:
Amount of gaps shots for each Section.
The base amount is calculated on the amount of levels per Section, 7 in gauntlet, 5-7 in adventure.

For reference decimals will go up.
50% : 4 gauntlet 3-4 adventure
150% : 11 gauntlet 8-11 adventure
Minimum will be 1 gap shot.
options.doc_fr:
Nombre d'écarts pour chaque section.
Le montant de base est calculé sur le montant des niveaux par section, 7 en guntlet, 5-7 en aventure.

Pour les décimales de référence montera.
50% : 4 gantelets 3-4 aventure
150% : 11 gauntlet 8-11 aventure
Minimum sera 1 trou.

options.name: Combos per Section
options.doc:
Amount of combos shots for each Section. (groups destroyed after a shot)
The base amount is calculated on the amount of levels per Section, 7 in gauntlet, 5-7 in adventure.

For reference decimals will go up.
50% : 4 gauntlet 3-4 adventure
150% : 11 gauntlet 8-11 adventure
Minimum will be 1 combos shot.
options.doc_fr:
Quantité de combos pour chaque section. (groupes détruits après un coup de feu)
Le montant de base est calculé sur le montant des niveaux par section, 7 en guntlet, 5-7 en aventure.

Pour les décimales de référence montera.
50% : 4 gantelets 3-4 aventure
150% : 11 gauntlet 8-11 aventure
Le minimum sera 1 combos.

options.name: Max Combo requirement
options.doc: The amount of Combos to made with one shot required to send the check.

options.name: Chain length
options.doc: The length of the chain to made required to send the check.

options.name: Gauntlet Level Selection
options.doc:
Determines which Boards from Gauntlet can be considered for inclusion in the multiworld.

Set any Level you don't want to possibly play to false.

A minimum of 5 Levels must be selected to play.

If space is selected as goal but not here, only clearing the goal will be the only check in space
valid_keys: Board 14 - Lair of The Mud Snake

options.name: Gauntlet Levels Amount
options.doc: Determines how many levels will be picked from your selection from Gauntlet to include in the multiworld.

options.name: gauntlet_difficulty
options.doc:
Determines the Goal difficulty for the Gauntlet.
Each lower difficulty will be location.

options.name: Adventure Level Selection
options.doc:
Determines which stages from adventure can be considered for inclusion in the multiworld.

Set any Level you don't want to possibly play to false.

A minimum of 4 Levels must be selected to play.

options.name: Adventure Levels Amount
options.doc: Determines how many levels will be picked from your selection from Gauntlet to include in the multiworld.
